A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DeepSeek-R1 Thoughtology study. Complete text extraction and rendered-page comparison support matching the main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–J despite shifted pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original reasoning-chain analyses, mathematical-reasoning evaluations, HarmBench results, and CountDown training experiments in Sections 3–11.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds an annotated GSM8K reasoning trace in Figure B.3.

M1.justification: The reasoning taxonomy, annotation procedure, and Section 11.2 training and reward formulations are unchanged. The additional trace does not modify a method or model.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage is unchanged. Figure B.3 presents another GSM8K mathematical word problem, within coverage already present in v1.

E2.justification: Existing comparator sets are unchanged, including the model baselines in Table 6 and reward variants in Section 11. The new example introduces no comparator.

E3.justification: Reported evaluation settings, metrics, sample counts, and training budgets are unchanged, including the default temperature of 0.6 and the 900/1300-step CountDown training schedules. Figure B.3 introduces no distinct evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Appendix B.2 adds a qualitative case study in Figure B.3: DeepSeek-R1 repeatedly questions whether a download must restart after already reaching the correct answer. Existing analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Repeated-run information, statistical procedures, and uncertainty reporting are unchanged. The additional reasoning trace includes no new statistical estimate or test.

E6.justification: Figure B.3 newly reports a GSM8K response that reaches 160 minutes, repeatedly revisits the restart assumption, and ultimately retains that answer. Existing quantitative results, rankings, and qualitative examples are unchanged.

T1.justification: Formal mathematical content, including the reward equations in Section 11.2, is unchanged. The added model-response example introduces no theoretical result or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's primary findings, and conclusions retain the same scientific claims, including persistent rumination and limitations of longer reasoning.

C2.justification: v1 already interprets repeated reconsideration as rumination in Sections 3.3 and 12. The new appendix paragraph applies that interpretation to another example; mechanisms, applicability qualifications, and Section 12.1 limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: The setup in Section 2.4, training details in Section 11.2, annotation instructions in Figure B.1, and resource-access statements are unchanged. The addition is an illustrative problem and response.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and research positioning are unchanged. Figure B.3 repeats the existing GSM8K citation to Cobbe et al. (2021).

P1.justification: The title changes from 'Let’s <think> about LLM reasoning' to 'Let’s think about LLM reasoning'. Section 3.3 gains a cross-reference, and Appendix B.2 gains a short explanatory paragraph; the remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds the color-annotated Figure B.3 and its caption. Text reflow also pushes two concluding lines of Section 3 onto a nearly empty page. Existing figure and table displays remain unchanged apart from pagination.

improvement.justification: Figure B.3 makes the existing rumination claim more concrete: highlighted excerpts show the correct 160-minute answer followed by repeated reconsideration. This modest gain in explanatory evidence outweighs the small layout regression from the two-line spillover page; quantitative validation, methods, and limitations remain unchanged.
